resolutions.resolution: When random function needs to be evaluated as part of arbitrary substitution function, use a different UA ident, using own set of indices, unrelated to later index resolution
resolutions.background: There is [an existing issue](https://github.com/w3c/csswg-drafts/issues/10982) about random() and other tree scope functions used outside element context, so it is unclear how random() should behave in `@container` style queries now. However we can also use random() in style() condition inside `if()`:
irc: <dshin-moz> TabAtkins: Next one is similar, but different context
<dshin-moz> ... What happens when you use random in arbitrary subtitution functions with early resolution?
<dshin-moz> ... e.g. test of an if()
<TabAtkins> if(style(random(1) = random(2)): random(3); else: random(4));
<dshin-moz> ... 4 different random values, need to resolve first two during substitution, 3rd and 4th may not be resolved
<dshin-moz> ... We don't want to get these tied together
<dshin-moz> ... By default, we capture the index of the random usage. Using the same random function 2 times in the same property will give the same value by default
<dshin-moz> ... How do we capture in case when some are resolved early, and some resolve later, as part of the value?
<dshin-moz> ... If there are multiple ifs, how do the work?
<dshin-moz> ... My proposal is that if we're resolving randoms early, we capture that we are resolving early, into UA random ident, to force them into later usages
<dshin-moz> ... In the example, 1 and 2 are captured as an index, 3 and 4 are unresolved and substituted later
<TabAtkins> calc( if(style(random(1) = random(2)): random(3); else: random(4)) + random(5))
<dshin-moz> ... In the longer example, where we mix random(3) and (4) are not resolved early, random(5) is out of if
<dshin-moz> ... end result, (1) and (2) are captured as early, different random values. (3) and (4) dont capture anything yet
<TabAtkins> z-index: calc(random(3) + random(5))
<Rossen> q
<dshin-moz> ... Final result only contains the random from the if path + the one out of if
<dshin-moz> ... So we don't tie early-resolved random invocations to later-resolved random calls
<dshin-moz> Rossen: Ask is to accept this proposal?
<dshin-moz> TabAtkins: Yes
<dshin-moz> PROPOSED: When random function needs to be evaluated as part of arbitrary substitution function, use a different UA ident, using own set of indices, unrelated to later index resolution
<dshin-moz> Rossen: Any objections?
<flackr> q+
<Rossen> ack flackr
<dshin-moz> flackr: None of this applies if dev creates shared random context?
<dshin-moz> TabAtkins: Correct, this is the UA default behaviour
<dshin-moz> flackr: It's not really observable, then two stages of evaluation are different?
<dshin-moz> TabAtkins: Yes
<dshin-moz> flackr: That sounds reasonable
<TabAtkins> (it will have disappeared as part of substitution, before the next point it's observable)
<dshin-moz> RESOLVED: When random function needs to be evaluated as part of arbitrary substitution function, use a different UA ident, using own set of indices, unrelated to later index resolution
